name: centrosomal protein 43
pathways: negative regulation of protein kinase activity

function.text: CEP43 encodes centrosomal protein 43. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and protein tyrosine kinase inhibitor activity. It participates in negative regulation of protein kinase activity and microtubule anchoring.
